newsitem.title: GERMANY: Pan-German June cpi inflation +1.7 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Pan-German June cpi inflation +1.7 pct yr/yr.

text.p: German inflation remained subdued in June, with consumer prices rising 1.7 percent from the year-earlier month, and 0.2 percent from the previous month, the Federal Statistics Office said on Friday.
In May, consumer prices had risen 1.6 percent and 0.4 percent, respectively.
In west Germany, the CPI increase was given as 1.7 percent, compared with a preliminary figure of 1.6 percent reported in late June.
In east Germany, inflation was 1.9 percent year-on-year, and 0.1 percent month-on-month.
